purpose: Advance global branch clock from 5 Jun T24 through 10 Jun T24, then hand primary adjudication to Marianas on 11 Jun while retaining event-trigger background watches.
core_decisions: OVERLORD occurs 6 Jun as already-authorized five-beach historical-class first wave.
TF58 sortie proceeds 6-7 Jun; Majuro strike friction is absorbed before the 11 Jun attack.
Japanese ISR confirms major US carrier sortie by 9 Jun; Yamamoto starts preliminary A-GO measures but does not sortie the five-carrier core by 10 Jun.
Historical KON/Biak detachment is absent; Yamato/Musashi remain in the main Pacific fleet pool.
Tawi-Tawi Harder cluster is re-adjudicated: Hayanami lost, Minazuki/Tanikaze survive this window.
Hengyang remains Chinese-held and becomes a background siege/node-transfer watch after 10 Jun.
hard_guards: Do not pre-award 11 Jun Marianas air combat.
Do not reuse historical Toyoda command chain; Yamamoto remains CINC Combined Fleet.
Do not inherit historical KON/Biak movements or Harusame loss.
Do not inherit historical Minazuki/Tanikaze June losses after this settlement.
Do not credit I-34/I-29 German hardware ashore before actual arrival events.
